2. Plan draft 6, chapter-plan/draft-6-proposed.md: one page of changes and the new order (group 1 above).
3. The reviewer experience, team/conductor/projects/reviewer-experience/README.md: the first ten minutes (group 2).
4. LAB 01, lab/pdf/the-ultimate-insider-lab.pdf: the designer's visual language and ruv.sgit's first experiment.
5. The publishers study (/research/publishers/) and the /publishers/ page's wording (group 3).
7. Briefs 1 and 2 on /updates/: the day so far and your asks replayed.
